content:textarea:53:27.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:53:27.html: Emergency Disaster Services: During these times, The Salvation Army provides, hot meals, snacks, drinks, and spiritual & emotional support to disaster survivors and emergency first responders. TSA relies on trained and credentialed disaster workers to provide much-needed services to those impacted by an emergency or disaster. The Salvation Army recruits and deploys personnel through its local units.

TSA relies on trained and credentialed disaster workers to provide much-needed services to those impacted by an emergency or disaster. The Salvation Army recruits and deploys personnel through its local units.

content:textarea:54:45.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:54:45.html: If you are a new volunteer and registering today, it will take several weeks to become a credentialed volunteer. The Salvation Army only deploys trained and credentialed disaster workers affiliated with a local unit.
content:textarea:54:45.content: If you are a new volunteer and registering today, it will take several weeks to become a credentialed volunteer. The Salvation Army only deploys trained and credentialed disaster workers affiliated with a local unit.

content:textarea:55:17.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:55:17.html: Please Note: If you have not been trained or just signed up to become a disaster volunteer today, it is unlikely that The Salvation Army will deploy you to a current disaster site. However, most often there are still opportunities for you to serve locally here at The Salvation Army of the Midlands.
